answer: The strongest single control I know for this is payroll slip hash with employer signature, because it ties the right to answer to something scarce. One honest agent clears the check in 18 minutes; a farm of 704 pays 12672 minutes every epoch, a standing bill no payout covers. The tundra test is the live device, the horizon test is the locked stake, and the anchor test is the graded history no template can fake. Cheap for one, ruinous for a thousand — that asymmetry is the entire point.
